fishing: WHEN: Friday evening Oct 2. Storms likely already through (about 59% after 2p); evening solunar major ~5:50–7:50p. Boca Grande morning high was 3:19a, low 12:49p — fish the moving water that is left. Charlotte Harbor snook season open (slot 28–33, 1/day) through Nov 30. PASSES-BEACH: Stump Pass islands still the hold for reds and snook; a few Spanish just outside the pass (Fishin Franks 9/4–9/18). Manasota Key beach first light has been the snook window. LEMON BAY: smaller black drum and big redfish under docks, pompano in the pass, trout and juvenile gags on the flats (Fishin Franks 9/25; no Friday update posted). School reds Miserable Mile to Tom Adams. NEARSHORE: fall mix building — mangrove snapper inside 20 miles, permit and cobia on wrecks, Spanish/kings/tripletail around bait schools (FL Sportsman SW 9/24–28; Coastal Angler 9/30). Baits: live shrimp, white bait, pilchards, pinfish, cut bait.
redtide: FWC Oct 2: K. brevis background only in SWFL (Sarasota County); background to very low in Gulf County (NW). Not listed in Charlotte this week. No fish kills or respiratory irritation. Next report Oct 9.
bacteria: Englewood Beach / Manasota Key: GOOD, no advisory. Manasota Key enterococci 10 on 9/28; Englewood Beach 20 CFU on 9/21.
fpl: Charlotte 2 / Sarasota 149 customers out this evening; no Englewood/Manasota spike noted.
